name: adjust_stock_item_count

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_AdjustStockItemCount consumes an item ID and signed amount and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: ScriptCommand_AdjustStockItemCount adds amount to the stock byte at D_003010F8 + 0x499 + item_id and clamps the result to the inclusive range 0 through 99. Unlike command 253 get_total_item_count, this updates only unequipped stock and does not inspect character item slots. The JP corpus contains 164 calls.
